correctness.rationale: The Brownian hitting-time density gives an exact killed-excursion success probability q=exp(-2sqrt(a) log N). Laplace minimization of 1/z+az controls bounded-time successes. The theorem holds for every fixed a>=0, with the no-reset case handled separately. All 209 standalone numerical consistency assertions passed; those finite checks supplement the proof.

value.rationale: Population-scale restarting is a natural perturbation of extreme Brownian search, with a previously unidentified sharp threshold separating two qualitatively different fastest-arrival distributions and timescales.
